einzeiler: Larry Millete sentenced for wife's murder, plus restaurant owners' trial and manhunts.
kurzfassung: Larry Millete receives 25 years to life for the 2021 murder of his wife Maya, whose body remains missing. In Ohio, a business partner stands trial for the double murder of a local restaurant-owning couple. The episode also covers legal updates on Lori Vallow Daybell and Lindsay Clancy, alongside insights into fugitive manhunts.
stichpunkte: Larry Millete is sentenced to 25 years to life after being convicted of murdering his wife Maya.
Maya's body has never been found, leaving her family desperate for answers and closure.
During the sentencing, emotional statements are delivered by family members and the couple's children.
In Ohio, Andrew Griffin goes on trial for the 2021 shooting deaths of business partners Tom and Angela Strussion.
Prosecutors present evidence including burner phone data and surveillance footage of a motorcycle.
The defense argues that the prosecution's star witness, Brett Cole, is an unreliable felon.
Legal appeals and hearings continue in high-profile cases involving Lori Vallow Daybell and Lindsay Clancy.
Retired U.S. Marshal Lenny DePaul shares expertise on the strategies used to track down dangerous fugitives.

clips.text: Maya's sister confronts Larry directly in court, stating that his escalating paranoia and abuse ultimately destroyed their family.
The proceedings are interrupted when static interference repeatedly triggers Larry's father's pacemaker, leading to his evacuation on a stretcher.
According to testimony from the co-conspirator, the gunman shot Angela when she rushed toward him before demanding money from Tom once again.
The trial judge removed Lori Vallow Daybell's initial attorney early in the case due to a potential conflict with her husband's representation.

clips.hook: You can run, but you can't hide
clips.text: The retired marshal emphasizes that fugitives ultimately accomplish nothing by fleeing except exhausting themselves before capture.

beschreibung:
In San Diego County, emotions run high at the sentencing of Larry Millete, the man convicted of killing his wife Maya as she sought a divorce. In Ohio, Andrew Griffin is accused of killing business partners Tom and Angela Strussion over a business deal gone bad. In Dateline Round Up, an update on Lori Vallow Daybell, known as "Mommy Doomsday," convicted of murdering two of her children and conspiring to murder others. New details in the case of Michelle Parker, a woman who went missing after appearing on the TV show The People's Court in 2011. Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother who says she was experiencing postpartum psychosis when she killed her three children, is back in court for a hearing. Plus, a retired U.S. marshal explains how investigators track down fugitives.

Find out more about the cases covered each week here: www.datelinetruecrimeweekly.com.
